posts.title: VP Con
posts.body:
OUAD will be attending the first annual VPCon board game convention brought to you by the Across the Board game group in Central Wisconsin. We will be hosting a table and some game demos. Also enter the raffle to get a chance to win one of our games!



**Registration Pricing**

Adults $15

Students $10

Kids under 12 free

*Game library: Come check out our games or bring your own. Worried about finding a group to play your favorite game? Sign up to host an event!*



\- Silent auction 9am – 4pm: got some games sitting on the shelf? Bring ’em to sell, no auction fee.

\- Raffle prizes: Winning tickets will be drawn at 8pm (must be present to win). Check in later for prize title!

\- The Springville Sports Barn restaurant will be open for business. (No carry-ins allowed).



**Volunteers**

We are looking for volunteers to help out (library, teaching games, or check-in).



3 hours volunteering = free admission!

posts.title: Madison Night Market - May
posts.body: Madison Night Market May was a huge success! We couldn't have asked for a better start to the convention season. Big shout out to the MNM organizers and all the wonderful people that showed up. Had so many great interactions that has left us energized to do more!

posts.title: Summer Update #1
posts.summary: First Summer Update for Once Upon a Dice
posts.body:
Quick update from Once Upon a Dice!

We recently attended ArtJune in Baraboo, and while it was a little outside our usual crowd, it turned out to be an interesting and productive day. Huge thanks again to our friend Chad for helping us out with the event!

On the game front, Blood Moon Rising is coming along really well. I just submitted the final three images to our artist, which means we are officially getting close to the finish line. I’m sure there will still be a few final tweaks, but the game is really starting to come together — and it looks fantastic.

Amy and I have been grinding away on the mechanics, testing, adjusting, reworking, and probably accidentally designing ten other games in the process. But honestly, it has all been worth it. By the time Blood Moon Rising is finished, it’s going to be the best version we can possibly make.

We’re especially excited about the new challenge elements in the game. Players will have plenty to do beyond hacking and slashing their way through monsters, with some fun objectives that should make every session feel a little different.

A few of our other projects will probably go into a light freeze for now while summer gets busy. Shore Leave, Gen Con, and Madison Night Market are all coming up fast, so we’ve got a wild few weeks ahead!

Hope you’re all having a great summer. Here’s a sneak peek at our most recent card back style — hope you like it!
